To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the distribution of distance for Twitter users is bimodal, with a peak at 10 miles for nearby friends, and a peak at 2500 miles for news sources.
the strength of a tie between two people in social media can be strongly correlated to the distance between the two people.
the distance between a user pair is strongly correlated with their tie strength.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how social media users are connected and what this means for their social networks.
how distance affects the strength of social ties, and we show that distance can be a strong indicator of the strength of social media ties, even though the users may not know each other.
how social ties are affected by distance, and how this distance is reflected in the social network structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the distance between two users in Twitter is strongly related to their strength of tie.
the strength of the relationship between two people is strongly related to the distance between them, and that the relationship is not monotonic.
distance is an indicator of tie strength, with the exception of very close distances.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the distance between a user and his/her follower/friend is not random and it is not a constant value.
the strength of ties in Twitter is not a function of distance, but rather a function of the type of relationship between two users.
we find a strong relationship between the distance between a user pair and the strength of the relationship between them, and that this is a function of the number of ways they are connected.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use the strength of the ties between a user and their friends to predict the geographic distance between them.
the strength of the relationship between two users is strongly correlated with their distance, and can be used to infer distance between users.
the distance between a user pair can be predicted from the tie strength, and vice versa.
